messages.en:
{07 00 00}Well, we've been through
a lot this year.

{07 14 00}Actually, I think this last
year hasn't even been all
that awful, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}No jellyfish tides or
Sasquatch invasions,{01 00 00 05 00} so
hey, I guess we're all right!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Noh, me oleme sel aastal
palju läbi elanud.

{07 14 00}Tegelikult arvan, et see
viimane aasta polnudki nii
hull, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}Ei mingeid meduusiparvesid
ega metsakollide sissetunge,{01 00 00 05 00}
nii et vist on meil hästi!

messages.en:
Hey, you know how that old
{ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00} guy{01 00 00 05 00} has a
year-end {ff 00 00 03}countdown{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 16 00}Well, the old fossil gets
up and starts partying
before the sun is even up!
{07 0e 00}Man, that's just not right.
messages.et:
Hei, tead, kuidas sellel
vanal {ff 00 00 06}Tortimeril{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00} on
aastalõpu {ff 00 00 03}loendus{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 16 00}Noh, see vana kivistis
ärkab ja hakkab pidutsema
enne päikesetõusu!
{07 0e 00}Poiss, see pole õige.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Crazy old {ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00} woke
everybody up this morning
with his stupid {ff 00 00 03}countdown{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 16 00}He's been partying in the
{ff 00 00 08}plaza{ff 00 00 00} all day, and he's
starting to wig out.
{07 06 00}I bet he's going to lose it
here in a bit, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 11 00}This'll be fun to watch.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hull vana {ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00} äratas
täna hommikul kõik oma
rumala {ff 00 00 03}loendusega{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 16 00}Ta on terve päeva {ff 00 00 08}väljakul{ff 00 00 00}
pidutsenud ja hakkab
peast segi minema.
{07 06 00}Vean kihla, et ta kaotab
varsti kontrolli, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 11 00}Seda on lõbus vaadata.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Even so, I guess the ol'
guy needs to fill the ol'
wrinkly hours somehow.
{07 00 00}{07 19 00}Still, don't you think he
should've just taken up
shuffleboard or something?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Isegi nii, vist peab vanake
oma kortsus tunnid kuidagi
täitma.
{07 00 00}{07 19 00}Ikkagi, kas sa ei arva, et
ta oleks pidanud pigem
malet mängima või midagi?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Now that it's finally gettin'
dark, I can actually feel
like the year's almost over.
{07 06 00}I don't know whether to
feel crabby about it or
shout a fat "Wooohooo!"
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nüüd, kui lõpuks hämarduma
hakkab, tunnen tõesti, et
aasta on peaaegu läbi.
{07 06 00}Ma ei tea, kas olla selle
pärast tusane või hüüda
kõva „Vuuhuu!”

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've weathered a lot in the
past year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

So I just hope this
headwind turns into a
tailwind. Know what I mean?
{07 11 00}I could totally just rule
this town if things start
going my way!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olen viimasel aastal
palju üle elanud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

Nii et loodan, et see
vastutuul muutub soodsaks.
Saad aru?
{07 11 00}Ma võiksin seda linna
täiesti valitseda, kui asjad
hakkaksid mulle sobima!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}So, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} this is
almost it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

Y'know, the moment when
the big odometer in the
sky finally rolls over.{07 19 00}
{07 00 00}In one hour, we're all
gonna{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 09 00}turn into wind!{01 01 00} {07 00 00}Or
something, heh.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Nii, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} see on
peaaegu käes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

Tead küll, see hetk, mil
suur odomeeter taevas
lõpuks üle veereb.{07 19 00}
{07 00 00}Ühe tunni pärast muutume
me kõik{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 09 00}tuuleks!{01 01 00} {07 00 00}Või
midagi, heh.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So this year ends, and
another year rounds the
bend{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}huh?
Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} I wonder
if things will turn around
for me this year?
{07 00 00}Maybe all my schemes will
come true!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 13 00}Here's to next
year.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii et see aasta lõpeb ja
teine aasta tuleb
nurga tagant{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}mis?
Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} huvitav,
kas asjad pöörduvad mul
sel aastal paremaks?
{07 00 00}Ehk lähevad kõik mu plaanid
täide!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 13 00}Järgmise aasta
terviseks.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Well, the {ff 00 00 03}countdown {ff 00 00 00}is
almost over, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{ff 00 00 03}

{ff 00 00 00}{07 00 00}All this New Year insanity
is starting to freak me
out.
Maybe {ff 00 00 06}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00} will{ff 00 00 03}
{ff 00 00 00}comfort me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Noh, {ff 00 00 03}loendus {ff 00 00 00}on peaaegu
läbi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{ff 00 00 03}

{ff 00 00 00}{07 00 00}Kogu see aastavahetuse
hullus hakkab mind
segaseks ajama.
Ehk lohutab {ff 00 00 06}{04 0b 00}{ff 00 00 00} mind,{ff 00 00 03}
{ff 00 00 00}jah, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Ack!{01 00 00 14 00} We've got less than
a minute left, {04 1f 00}!

{07 0e 00}Is there anything I should
be doing in this last
minute, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ahh!{01 00 00 14 00} Meil on vähem kui
minut aega, {04 1f 00}!

{07 0e 00}Kas on midagi, mida ma
peaksin sel viimasel
minutil tegema, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Whoa, can you believe it's
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} already,{ff 00 00 02}
{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Thanks for, you know,
putting up with all my
crabbiness last year{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0d 00}And hey,{01 00 00 05 00} no hard feelings,
right, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}Happy new year,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}I know how you can be.
{07 0d 00}But maybe you should try
being nice, just for today.
{07 11 00}'Cause you know, being
surly on New Year's Day will
jinx your whole year!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Head uut aastat,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Ma tean, milline sa oled.
{07 0d 00}Aga ehk peaksid proovima
kena olla, ainult täna.
{07 11 00}Sest tead, tusane olemine
uusaastapäeval nõiub kogu
su aasta ära!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}
Happy new year,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}This year, you and me are
gonna conquer this town!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00}
Head uut aastat,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}Sel aastal vallutame sina
ja mina selle linna!
